risk_if_not_implemented: Without Stateful Hash-Based Signatures for Firmware & Code Signing, residual security, compliance, or resilience risk may accumulate, potentially leading to control failures or non-compliance.

compensating_control_1.name: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to securely implement an internal Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) infrastructure or obtain PKI services from a reputable PKI service provider.
compensating_control_1.justification: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) (CRY-08) provides cryptographic protection and key governance that compensates for the absence of Stateful Hash-Based Signatures for Firmware & Code Signing (QTS-06.2) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative or complementary cryptographic mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Configuration Enforcement
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to monitor, enforce and report on configurations for endpoint devices.
compensating_control_2.justification: Configuration Enforcement (CFG-06) provides configuration and supply-chain hardening that compensates for the absence of Stateful Hash-Based Signatures for Firmware & Code Signing (QTS-06.2) by enforcing secure settings and trusted software sources to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
